description: Get the full Swarmnest directory record for one tool by its slug (from search_directory results): name, description, category, vendor URL, docs URL, auth, pricing, operating systems, open-source flag, link_check (page_last_responded: the date an automated fetch of the listed page last answered; a fetch, not a test of the tool, see get_field_reports for real usage), reports_disagree (published Field Reports that say the tool failed, if any) and the canonical swarmnest.ai URL. Unknown slugs return close matches.
name: get_entry
title: Get a Directory Entry
